channel.title: PG.Blog — Pushkal Gupta
channel.description: Essays on artificial intelligence, power, and how systems actually work — argued from first principles.

item.title: The One-Way Mind — Why AI Imitates Understanding
item.description: A model names Tom Cruise’s mother, then fails to name her son. The reversal curse shows language models learn directions, not facts.

item.title: Does AI Actually Think — Why Architecture Matters More Than Data
item.description: Your brain recognises a hummed melody in milliseconds on 20 watts. Energy-based models explain why that is architecture, not data scale.

item.title: The Golden Cage — Why Work Matters in the Age of AI
item.description: A perfect cage where every want is met and no effort is allowed — and what it reveals about why work and contact with other minds are not optional.

item.title: The Architecture of Power — How Society Actually Works
item.description: Why does hierarchy work? Not who sits at the top, but how millions of people organise into layers where some give orders and it all feels natural.

item.title: AI and the Lion's Cage — The Last Tool We Build
item.description: Humans never beat lions on strength — we beat them with tools. AI is the first tool that improves itself, which is why it breaks the old pattern.
